additions.name: Hillwood Reguły — service complex 3

status.summary: The October 2 municipal ruling confirms the planned HE4 Warsaw 4 data-storage service complex 3 and suspends the environmental decision procedure pending the mandatory impact report. No physical construction start is established; this administrative suspension is not a paused construction project.

locator.precision: Computed interior centroid of one exact full project parcel; not an authority-published point, building pin, or full-campus boundary.
locator.identity_review: Fresh municipal rulings identify applicant HE4 Warsaw 4 and full parcel 385 in Reguły for the server-room service complex 3. KRS identifies EU Industrial Club IV as its sole shareholder; UOKiK identifies that shareholder as part of Hillwood. Developer identifies the four-building Reguły campus. ULDK returns exact cadastral parcel 142104_2.0013.385; centroid containment is verified.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No surveyed error bound is provided. Direct parcel vector replaces the rejected Europe 3 image fit; point precision does not quantify source accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: All five verified_construction_core/2026-10-28-research-hundredfifth tables (862 sites/930 projects), 95 published holds, 14 local holds and 9 queue/coverage files screened. No selected-base matching site or project; earlier Reguły holds are this same lead. Nearest existing site is Sien Real Piaseczno Data Center (ul. Energetyczna), 14.463 km away. One physical campus and one specifically evidenced service-complex project are proposed; the remaining campus buildings are not separate sites.
additions.successor_review: Reviewed current municipal environmental index and project-specific September 4/October 2 rulings plus September 15 developer announcement on October 28. October 2 is the newer primary observation: the environmental procedure awaits an impact report. No later permit, start, cancellation, relocation or operating observation was found in the inspected index/search. Procedural suspension is retained explicitly, not recoded as physical construction paused.

scoped_project_details.facility_scope: One planned server-room service complex with offices and technical infrastructure within the four-building Reguły campus. Campus marker is inside the full parcel 385 assigned to this complex.
scoped_project_details.developer: Hillwood group; application entity HE4 Warsaw 4 sp. z o.o.
scoped_project_details.roles_limitation: Developer/investor relationship documented but no operator is named. No operator or owner role is invented.
scoped_project_details.capacity_limitation: Generator ratings in the EIA record are not normalized into IT capacity. No completed, commissioned or operational capacity claimed.

additions.name: Tecto TGRU1 hyperscale campus development

status.summary: The original operator post dated 3 September explicitly describes TGRU1 as currently under construction in Santana de Parnaíba. It supports physical campus development without specifying a building stage, achieved capacity or opening date. The 200 MW figure remains planned campus capacity, not operating IT load.

locator.precision: Interior point of the specific Tecto property outlined on municipal plan page 14, corresponding to merged glebas 11–16 on Estrada da Bela Vista. It is a derived campus locator, not an official published coordinate, surveyed boundary or exact proposed building position.
locator.identity_review: Municipal pages 10–14 explicitly identify the Aurea Finvest / Tectodigital III data-centre project and show its land and Tecto area in Santana de Parnaíba. The operator identifies its named Santana de Parnaíba hyperscale development as TGRU1. This identity bridge is based on the named company, municipality and matching project context, not legal-company numbering as a TGRU code. Five identifiable surrounding road controls register the map; two unused checkpoints and the full road overlay corroborate alignment. The selected source pixel lies well inside the yellow project outline. The water-connection endpoint is not used as the campus point.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Source map is schematic and has no usable CRS or measured accuracy. Control-fit RMS is 6.93 m and two unused checkpoint residuals are recorded in geometry-facts.json, but these are alignment diagnostics, not absolute positional accuracy. No surveyed boundary is claimed.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked all five hundredfifth base files (862 sites, 930 projects), tracked holds and available local queues (108 files). Historical TGRU1 and Americas3 holds refer to this same project. The municipal property is distinct from the nearest ODATA SP01 campus at 1194.0 m; no city, ODATA, Equinix or power-infrastructure point is substituted. One campus and one development project are added; the three schematic buildings are not counted separately.
additions.successor_review: Bounded primary searches through 28 October and the current operator facility page found no later completion, operation, pause or cancellation. The undated page continues to describe TGRU1 under construction. Historical preliminary environmental licence material supplies identity and land only; its favourable recommendation and grid approvals are not treated as construction evidence or issued installation consent. The 3 September observation is retained.

scoped_project_details.address: Estrada da Bela Vista, Tanquinho, Santana de Parnaíba, SP
scoped_project_details.power_scope: Planned campus total; not asserted as IT load or achieved capacity

additions.name: OneCloud Akbou — inaugurated pilot facility

status.summary: A participating public institution reports the achieved inauguration of OneCloud’s Akbou data centre. This records an inaugurated facility only. The participating sponsor dates the ceremony to 1 October. Full commercial service rollout and operating IT capacity remain unverified; the operator distinguishes an October pilot from planned national service in January 2027.

locator.precision: Named operator facility point at its explicitly labelled Akbou data-centre street address, not a street centroid, hotel venue or Algiers headquarters. No building footprint or surveyed accuracy claimed.
locator.identity_review: OneCloud’s own page labels Route de la Gare as Data Center Akbou and separately identifies its Algiers headquarters. Google’s named OneCloud Algeria feature matches that Akbou street and postcode and links onecloud.dz. The operator iframe is only a broad street search and is not the selected coordinate. The event hotel is excluded.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Community feature accuracy unknown; no cadastral boundary or internal data-hall location asserted.

additions.distinctness_review: Five selected baseline tables contain no OneCloud, One Cloud, Akbou or Tighremt matches. No existing Algeria site is present. Company office and ceremony venue are excluded. Unspecified Algérie Télécom replication is not another site.
additions.successor_review: Bounded primary review through 28 October finds current operator pilot and future national-rollout wording. It does not establish a later closure or physical relocation. A search-indexed founder post also forecasts October beta and January live; its origin returned404 and is not admitted evidence. No full-service operations date is inferred.

scoped_project_details.address: Route de la Gare, Akbou 06001, Béjaïa, Algeria
scoped_project_details.facility_scope: Named first commercial cloud facility; inauguration milestone only, with pilot versus national service rollout distinguished. Not a standalone university data centre or a technology demonstration.
